points.description: States that a steeper stream/basin slope makes runoff move faster and leave the catchment/basin more quickly.
points.partial_credit: Half if only says steeper means faster flow or high slope, without linking to runoff leaving the basin.

points.description: Links this to a smaller time base: since runoff drains out sooner after the storm, the time base (duration of the hydrograph) is reduced.
points.partial_credit: Half if mentions shorter time/duration but the reason is vague.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying that steeper slope makes runoff drain out quickly, so the hydrograph's time base is shorter, in any wording. Give part marks if only one side is clear (e.g. 'faster flow' or 'shorter time' with a vague link). Give no marks for wrong or unrelated reasoning, such as saying steep streams lengthen the time base.
